description: Department of Fiscal Policy - The Bilateral Agreement for affording relief from double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion entered into between Sri Lanka and Singapore
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the publication of a bilateral agreement between Sri Lanka and Singapore for the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion. It is a legal/regulatory instrument that modifies the tax framework and falls under the definition of "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" (Type 5) for new regulations and international agreements affecting the legal and tax system.
